quote: given an image, a machine has to answer the image-related questions in natural language by natural language.

We propose a simple data augmentation method SIMPLEAUG... questions annotated for one image can be valuable add-ons to other relevant images and design a series of mechanisms to "propagate" questions from one image to the others.

We propose a simple data augmentation method SIMPLEAUG, which relies on (i) the original image-question-answer triplets in the dataset, (ii) mid-level semantic annotations available on the training images (e.g., object bounding boxes), and (iii) pretrained object detectors.
outputs: augmented image-question-answer (IQA) triplets generated by propagating existing questions to other images and by paraphrasing similar questions
